reason: The README describes an operations toolkit whose primary purpose is automated local service recovery, supervised snapshot upgrades with rollback, session recovery, and terminal-based diagnosis and repair.

summaries.zh: 用于本地 DSH 服务的自动守护、会话恢复、A/B 版本轮换、验收回滚以及终端故障诊断与修复。
summaries.en: An operations toolkit for local DSH service monitoring, session recovery, validated A/B version rotation with rollback, and terminal-based diagnosis and repair.

capabilities: Installs and updates local skills and a plugin bundle
Builds and validates isolated A/B snapshots before switching versions
Restarts and monitors a local web service
Diagnoses and repairs local configuration, plugin, launcher, and session issues
Can invoke an LLM agent to analyze logs and perform repairs
